verdict.rationale: Rippling's payroll page says you can 'process payroll as often as you need', which covers the core of running payroll outside the regular schedule. It also documents one-off bonuses and one-off pay types. Missing for 10: explicit off-cycle run workflow documentation, coverage of correction and termination/final-pay off-cycle runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing copy.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run an off-cycle payroll for bonuses, corrections, or terminations outside the regular schedule

citations.quote: Stay flexible and process payroll as often as you need — at no extra charge.
Add one-off bonuses to payroll in seconds.
Select from default pay types or customize your own on a one-off or recurring basis.
